data.name: Velvet Emergency
data.detailed_description:
About This Game


Velvet Emergency is a tense, choice-driven visual novel set during one disastrous night inside an elite riverfront restaurant.

You play as Lera, a waitress working a closed political dinner at Velvet. The guests are powerful, the phones are confiscated, the cameras are off, and private security has locked the room while a hidden USB recording becomes the center of a scandal.

Then the service phone vibrates.

An upstream dam has failed. A surge wave and chemical plume are moving toward the district. The people in the dining room cannot leave, and the people who can open the doors care more about the scandal than the water outside.

Choose Under Pressure


Every decision changes the room. Warn the kitchen quietly, tell the guests directly, find the journalist posing as a sommelier, or keep the lie alive long enough to buy time.

Your choices affect panic, trust, supplies, evidence, leverage, and the minutes left before impact.

What Will You Carry?


The kitchen becomes a survival pantry. You cannot take everything.

Will you carry water, medicine, radios, keys, an axe, blankets, or evidence that could bring powerful people down?

A Disaster Movie In One Room


Velvet Emergency focuses on the human pressure of a catastrophe contained inside a beautiful place: red emergency lights on crystal, a phone drawer full of desperate calls, a service corridor standoff, a triage table, a wine cellar shelter, a rooftop rescue, and a black wave rising behind panoramic glass.

Features


  • A compact cinematic visual novel built in Ren'Py.
  • A chamber disaster-thriller premise set entirely around one luxury restaurant.
  • Visible pressure stats: time, panic, staff trust, guest trust, supplies, evidence, and leverage.
  • Moral choices about truth, lies, class, power, and who gets saved first.
  • Multiple routes: rooftop evacuation, wine cellar shelter, dining room barricade, staff exit, political bargain, truth release, and failure.
  • 15 hand-curated 1920x1080 visual scenes.

Content Note


Velvet Emergency contains disaster themes, political coercion, life-or-death choices, panic, and references to injury. It does not contain graphic gore.
